text:
Glad to meet you!
I'm Muneeb, a computer science student who builds websites, designs graphics and explores AI every day.
I'm a web designer and graphic designer, and I also edit photos. I like turning ideas into fast, animated and memorable web experiences.
Lately I'm deep into AI-generated cinematic video and images, using tools like Veo 3, Midjourney, Flux and Imagen.
Have a look at my live projects below, and if you like what you see, let's work together!
